evidence_registry.speaker: Elizabeth
evidence_registry.text: Um - so I really love this business, especially since I've had a seat in the arena before on this. And I think you have an amazing background. You've already gotten a lot of lessons learned from your first business and have done well, so I think you're thinking about everything in the right way. I think you're very crisp and knowledgeable about the levers of the business, and what you need to do, and I like how you think through optionality around the burn versus venture, etc. I think you sound like a fantastic entrepreneur. I think for me the valuation is really pricey. We're pre-seed investors, and I realize you're - you've actually made a lot of progress and are probably not what I would call in pre-seed. So from the perspective of the fund, we'll be out. But I think, you know, given where you are with your fundraise, if you end up, you know, raising a price round or whatever this is with those funds, I would love to see if I might be able to write a very, very small personal check.

rationales.explanation: Elizabeth directly says the valuation is pricey and that the company is no longer at the fund's pre-seed stage.
Elizabeth explicitly states that the fund is a pre-seed investor and will therefore be out from the fund perspective.
Elizabeth says she really loves the business.
She references having prior experience in this category as shaping her view.
She describes the founder as having an amazing background and sounding like a fantastic entrepreneur.
She positively assesses the founder's prior business performance, lessons learned, and practical thinking.
She calls the founder crisp and knowledgeable about the business levers and required actions.
She praises the founder's command of the business levers and ability to think through burn-versus-venture optionality.

unmapped_utterances: [184] Compared to some of us here -
[244] But I guess what we're saying is -
annotation_summary: Elizabeth's explicit Out rationale is the mismatch between the requested valuation/company stage and the fund's pre-seed mandate. Her other observed comments are positive assessments of the business and founder, including prior-category experience, founder execution, communication, and business command.
